programme.title: Fight For Life with Tony Granato: Ep 5 - The Journey Forward
programme.desc: Denna, Matt, AJ, and Jake each experienced life-altering spinal cord injuries that changed far more than their hockey careers. In an instant, the futures they had imagined looked completely different, and each was faced with the challenge of rebuilding a life on new terms. In this episode of Fight for Life, they share the realities of that journey, the unique gym that brought them together, and the friendships that have helped them navigate the challenges, find community, and discover a new way forward.
